GP DEEPA NARAYANAN  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD ON 04.06.2020, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 W.P.(C) No.15680 of 2010  2  JUDGMENT Dated this the 4th day of June, 2020.

The writ petition is filed seeking a declaration that the Schedules to Ext.P3, the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 2007 are in the nature of imposition of tax and ultra vires the powers of the first respondent and hence illegal.
The Food Adulteration Act has since been repealed and replaced with the Food Safety and Standards Act and therefore, the challenge against the PFA Rules has become infructuous.
In the result, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
